# ReShiki 0.13.0

This release shows molecules as 3D models, opens crystal structures with their unit cell and brings the editor to the web browser, with many more group abbreviations and a command palette.

- **3D models:** show a molecule as **3D** or **Both** from the right-click **Show as** menu. Choose ball & stick, stick, wireframe or space-filling, a flat or glossy look, then rotate and resize the model on the canvas. PNG, SVG and PDF draw it as vectors.
- **Crystal structures:** open CIF, PDB, POSCAR/CONTCAR and XYZ files. They open as 2D drawings with their unit cell, can repeat cells and look along an axis, and show as 3D models in their cell. A VESTA colour theme is included.
- **ReShiki in the browser:** try the editor at [reshiki.com/demo](https://reshiki.com/demo/), or add it to your own page with `bun add @ameyanagi/reshiki`. Naming and NMR prediction work there too; printing and the assistant need the desktop app, so use it whenever you can.
- **Faster on large drawings:** panning, zooming, hover, edits, copy and export are much faster on drawings with thousands of atoms, and Undo and long stereo chains use far less memory.
- **Typing groups:** 359 abbreviations, your own abbreviations from a selection, and reverse spellings such as **MeO** and **O2N** typed on a bond end.
- **Command palette:** press **:** to find and run any command, with values such as **rot 30** or **scale 150**. Help is a searchable shortcut finder.

The installed application remains one executable and works without Python or RDKit.

**Drawing compatibility:** older drawings remain readable. Every file saved by 0.13 uses document format 29, even when it uses no new feature, and cannot open in 0.12.x or earlier. Keep a copy saved by 0.12 if you share files with people who use it.

macOS downloads are signed and notarized. Windows and Linux downloads remain unsigned; Windows signing is pending.

[Complete changes and contributor credits](https://reshiki.com/developer/changes-0.13/) · [3D models](https://reshiki.com/developer/3d-keyboard-drawing/) · [Crystal structures](https://reshiki.com/developer/crystal-structures/) · [Browser preview](https://reshiki.com/demo/).
